note: Same variant shape as IPC-developer-team-additions.json. Slot 3 is the ace.

trainers.name: ALDER
trainers.theme: Unova's wandering champion: bugs, fighters and fire

lines.chat:
ALDER: I wander
to learn. Today I learn from you!
lines.intro:
ALDER: Show me
what you love!
lines.win:
Ha! You fight
with your heart.
lines.loss:
A good match is
a gift. Thanks!
lines.afterLoss:
ALDER: Rest, then
try me again!

trainers.name: BIANCA
trainers.theme: cheerful rival from Nuvema: fire starter and cuddly friends

lines.chat:
BIANCA: Oh! Wait
up! I got lost on the way here.
lines.intro:
BIANCA: I'll do
my very best!
lines.loss:
I did it! I
really did it!
lines.afterWin:
BIANCA: Next time
I won't get lost!

trainers.name: BURGH
trainers.theme: Castelia's artist leader: bugs as living art

lines.chat:
BURGH: Every bug
is a brushstroke.

trainers.name: CHEREN
trainers.theme: serious rival from Nuvema: steady normal types and a water starter

lines.chat:
CHEREN: What does
strength mean to you? I still ask.
lines.win:
I see. I have
more to learn.
lines.afterLoss:
CHEREN: Strong is
not the same as right. Remember.

trainers.name: CILAN
trainers.theme: Striaton connoisseur: grass types, served with flair

lines.chat:
CILAN: Let me
savor this match.
lines.afterWin:
CILAN: Your style
has real taste.
lines.afterLoss:
CILAN: A dash more
spice next time!

trainers.name: DRAYDEN
trainers.theme: Opelucid's mayor and dragon master

lines.chat:
DRAYDEN: Dragons
teach patience. I hope you have
some.

trainers.name: ELESA
trainers.theme: Nimbasa's shining model: electric types under the spotlight

lines.chat:
ELESA: The lights
are on. Ready?
lines.afterWin:
ELESA: You'd look
good on a runway.

trainers.name: GRIMSLEY
trainers.theme: Elite Four gambler: dark types, all in

lines.chat:
GRIMSLEY: Life's
a gamble. So is this match.
lines.win:
The dice turned.
So it goes.

trainers.name: IRIS
trainers.theme: young dragon champion from the Village of Dragons

lines.chat:
IRIS: Ooh, you
look really strong! Let's go!
lines.intro:
IRIS: My dragons
are fired up!
lines.loss:
Yay! The dragons
and me did it!
lines.afterWin:
IRIS: Next time
I'll win for sure!
lines.afterLoss:
IRIS: That was so
much fun!

trainers.name: MARSHAL
trainers.theme: Elite Four fighter, Alder's apprentice

lines.chat:
MARSHAL: My master
taught me to fight with a calm mind.
lines.afterLoss:
MARSHAL: Train
your body and your mind.

trainers.name: SHAUNTAL
trainers.theme: Elite Four novelist: ghost types and the stories they tell

lines.chat:
SHAUNTAL: Ah! A
new character for my next story!
lines.win:
What a twist!
I must write it.
lines.loss:
And so the tale
ends... for now.
lines.afterLoss:
SHAUNTAL: Every
story needs a sequel.

trainers.name: SKYLA
trainers.theme: Mistralton's pilot leader: birds of every size

lines.chat:
SKYLA: Cleared for
takeoff? Let's fly!
lines.win:
Whoa! You flew
right past me!
lines.afterWin:
SKYLA: I'll catch
you on the wind.
lines.afterLoss:
SKYLA: Keep your
head in the sky!

trainers.name: VALERIE
trainers.theme: Laverre's fairy-type designer

lines.chat:
VALERIE: Oh...
hello. I was lost in a daydream.
lines.win:
How lovely. You
are like silk.
lines.afterWin:
VALERIE: You have
a gentle power.

trainers.name: WALLACE
trainers.theme: Hoenn's water champion and contest star

lines.chat:
WALLACE: Battles
should be as beautiful as the
sea.

trainers.name: CYCLIST
trainers.theme: speedy cyclist: fast runners and fliers

lines.chat:
CYCLIST: I rode
here nonstop!

trainers.name: HARLEQUIN
trainers.theme: clown: tricksters and mimics

lines.chat:
HARLEQUIN: Step
right up! The show is free!

trainers.name: INFER
trainers.theme: fire-type girl (sheet name 'Infer')

lines.chat:
INFER: Is it hot
in here, or is it just my team?
lines.afterWin:
INFER: You put
my fire out!

trainers.name: SAGE
trainers.theme: robed fire sage (sheet name 'Infer sage')

lines.chat:
SAGE: The flame
reveals the truth.
lines.intro:
SAGE: Let the fire
judge us.

trainers.name: LINEBACKER
trainers.theme: football player: heavy rock and ground hitters

lines.chat:
LINEBACKER: Huddle
up! It's game day!
lines.afterLoss:
LINEBACKER: Good
game! Shake on it.

trainers.name: ROUGHNECK
trainers.theme: tough guy: poison, smog and muscle

lines.chat:
ROUGHNECK: What're
you lookin' at?

trainers.name: SOCIALITE
trainers.theme: high-society lady: elegant and pampered

lines.chat:
SOCIALITE: Oh my,
what a quaint little stadium.
lines.intro:
SOCIALITE: Do try
to keep up, dear.
